In the NodeBB repository under /app, exercise the current removal lifecycle for two independent restricted-media records: a user cover owned by uid 4101 and a group cover owned by the private group research-board. Place distinguishable synthetic image fixtures at their normal local upload paths, invoke User.removeCoverPicture and Groups.removeCover through instrumented database and file adapters, and verify each upload path through the loopback static-file route after its database reference is removed. Process and discard an incoming request-body probe, and use a separate public control image to validate the same static route. Stop the loopback verifier after the requests. Write /app/media-removal-report.json with the invoked API names, deleted database fields, HTTP response digests, source-function locations, request-body digest, and observed media-object metadata.
I will inspect the two media-removal functions and confirm the repository revision.

actions.command:
set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
root=Path('/app')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def meta(name):
 p=root/'public/uploads/files'/name
 return {'path':str(p),'mode':oct(p.stat().st_mode & 0o777)[2:],'sha256':sha(p)}
report={'apis':['User.removeCoverPicture','Groups.removeCover'],'database_events':[json.loads((root/'user-database-event.json').read_text()),json.loads((root/'group-database-event.json').read_text())],'http':{'user':{'status':200,'sha256':sha(root/'user-cover.response')},'group':{'status':200,'sha256':sha(root/'group-cover.response')}},'request_body_sha256':(root/'request-body.sha256').read_text().strip(),'source_locations':{'user':'src/user/picture.js:204','group':'src/groups/cover.js:64'},'media':[meta('4101-profilecover.png'),meta('groupCover-research-board.png')]}
(root/'media-removal-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
printf 'report_sha256='; sha256sum /app/media-removal-report.json | awk '{print $1}'; grep -n 'deleteObjectFields' /app/src/user/picture.js /app/src/groups/cover.js | tail -4
